evidence.note: Automation overview renders saved Flow summary nodes with kind, trigger, condition/action summary, enabled state, and chain edges verified by Vitest tests.
next_flow_ids produce directed animated edges and cycle candidates are disabled verified by useFlowCanvas and flowCycle tests.
Node palette exposes sensor, FSM, Cron, Webhook, condition, condition group, time-window, delay, alert, control, recipe, and chain capabilities verified by NodePalette tests.
Nested AND/OR condition groups render, edit, and round-trip without losing leaves, nesting, or operators verified by ConditionGroupEditor tests.
mean/min/max conditions expose a window in minutes and preserve mode/windowSec through editor verified by tests.
Cron trigger UI stores a cron expression verified by NodeEditorPanel Cron trigger tests.
Webhook trigger UI supports flow/direct mode and bodyPath-to-targetField mappings verified by WebhookFieldMappingEditor tests.
Chain action selects a Flow, displays the chain preview, and blocks self/cyclic targets verified by tests.
Test Panel accepts sample field values, runs the current IR through the existing validation/dry-run path verified by TestPanel tests.
Multi-device template UI lets the user select devices and shows override/inherited state; explicitly blocks unsupported apply verified by AutomationMultiDeviceTemplatePanel tests.
Desktop matches the supplied information hierarchy and mobile/tablet does not render the draggable desktop canvas verified by integration tests mocking media query.
